description: Second fresh-instance screen for issue #2. The first screen (task_cost_v1) tested a per-task constant and was looked at once. A calibration diagnostic then showed that a per-gate term also matters: on random circuits unrelated to every family below, the cross-validated median error of the collection-time fit is 50% without a fixed cost, 35% with a per-task term, 21% with a per-gate term and 13% with both. The rules below are evaluated on instances nobody has timed: new seed offsets, frozen before they were timed. The rule that ships is chosen from this screen alone.

calibration.source: seeded random circuits from calibrate_analysis_budget.random_batch, unrelated to any family below

regret.ranking: execution time of the candidate the rule selects / execution time of the fastest of full, separate, grouped; per instance, then median, p90 and geometric mean
regret.cross_validated: the fastest candidate is chosen on one session and the rule is timed on the other, averaged both ways
regret.collections: median collection time of the plan, after one warm-up

success_criteria.narrow_regime: no loss: the median ratio of selected to best stays within 1.02 of the current rule
success_criteria.reduction_wins: the narrow-cone instances keep selecting a cone plan
success_criteria.note: a rule ships only if its small-tree ranking regret falls and the narrow regime keeps its cone plans (share kept at least 0.95 and p90 within 1.05 of the current rule)
